about: Values the game keeps in a bounded range (table counts, record sizes). The gate maps a fuzzed value into the range (lo + value % (hi - lo + 1)) instead of letting a loop over it run to the instruction limit. where: global (the value at addr), global_ptr (field off of the object addr points to), this (field off of this), arg (field off of the buffer stack argument `arg` points to). shift/mask select a bitfield. func limits an entry to one function.

ranges.why: entry count of the sqgx texture table at 0x1099D618: 40-byte entries up to 0x109A2618, where g_sqgxRenderStateDirty starts; (0x109A2618 - 0x1099D618) / 40 = 512
entry count of the sqgx vertex shader table: handles int[1024] at 0x103B4910, key pairs int[2048] at 0x103B5910
g_pSqgxContext+0xB18 is the last texture stage index: loops run it + 1 times over 8-byte stage records; Direct3D 8 has 8 texture stages

CMoCamera_SetPathData copies (size - 2) 16-byte waypoints from source+0x20 (rep movsd); size is bits 7..25 of the record header. Bounded to 64 waypoints, inside both the source and the object (assumption: real path records are small)
CMoGeneratorClone_InitCloneFromSource copies (size - 6) 16-byte entries from source+0x60; same header format as CMoCamera_SetPathData
sub_1001C930 writes 2 * count 32-byte entries into a 2408-byte local buffer (75 entries): count <= 37

sub_1016FCD0 XOR-decodes (size - 8) bytes of the block arg 1 points to; size is the low 24 bits of its first dword. Bounded to 2 KB, inside the gate's buffer (assumption: real blocks fit their buffer)

ring-buffer head of 80 entries (16 bytes each, arrays at +0x40 and +0x540): zeroed at 0x1001B8BB, and its only update (0x1001BAC7) increments it and wraps at 0x4F; the readers index the ring with it unchecked
